description: Reads a business's Google posts (Updates, offers and events), newest first, and analyses how often the owner posts. Use it to judge posting cadence or before planning posts. source picks free browser reading, which sees only the newest post Maps shows on the profile's Overview, or paid DataForSEO, which reads the full list: about $0.003 per read plus $0.0015 per 10 posts. With source dataforseo it spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap, or with no cap set, is refused with an error saying so, and the same request within the cache window the user set in the extension (7 days unless changed) is served from the cache for nothing. spend says what was charged (null when nothing paid was called). The agent never sees the key. Returns business (name, source, readAt, placeId, cid, primaryCategory, address, phone, website, rating, reviewCount; each null when unknown); posts (text, publishedAt or null, relativeAge, hasMedia, link, kind: update, offer, event or unknown); analytics (count, lastPostAgeDays, last30, last90, medianIntervalDays, gaps of over 30 days, mediaShare, linkShare, kinds; a null figure means no dated post supports it); truncated (always true from the browser); and unknown. unknown is null only when the full list was read (source dataforseo), and then an empty list is a real finding: the profile has no posts. From the browser unknown is always a sentence saying why (only the newest post was seen, or Google's signed-out view hid them): how often the business posts is unknown, not zero; say so, and offer source dataforseo.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

business.description: Which business: exactly one of {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Ids from find_business or local_scan are exact; a name and city is searched in Maps and can match a different place with the same name.

max.description: The most posts to read, 1 to 100, newest first. Defaults to 30.

source.description: browser (the default) reads Maps in the user's Chrome for free. dataforseo pays from the user's DataForSEO key kept in the extension, within the monthly cap set there.

name: read_posts
title: Read posts
